atScene.en: Before grabbing any bag, ask three questions first: is the patient stable or critical, does the patient need fluid replacement, and will the patient need medications through this line — the answers, not what's within reach, decide isotonic versus hypotonic versus hypertonic.
atScene.zh: 拿液体袋之前先问三个问题：病人稳不稳定、要不要补液、这条通路要不要用来给药——答案决定选等张、低张还是高张，而不是手边有什么就用什么。

atScene.en: Large, easily visible arm veins can be deceptively hard to cannulate because they roll side to side during the stick; apply lateral traction to lock a rolling vein into position before advancing the needle.
atScene.zh: 看起来又粗又明显的手臂血管反而常常不好扎，因为下针时它会左右滑动；下针前先做侧向牵引把血管固定住再进针。

atScene.en: In patients with dark skin, iodine prep helps make veins more visible before venipuncture — as with any patient, confirm there is no iodine allergy first.
atScene.zh: 深色皮肤的病人，用碘伏备皮能让血管更容易看清——和对任何病人一样，用之前先确认没有碘过敏。

atScene.en: After two failed attempts, let your partner try — this is a written practice guideline, not a personal failure.
atScene.zh: 两次穿刺失败后就换搭档来——这是操作规范写明的做法，不是谁没本事的问题。

atScene.en: If you meet valve resistance, elevate the extremity and try again; if the line keeps infiltrating, try the next attempt without a constricting band.
atScene.zh: 遇到静脉瓣阻力时抬高肢体再试一次；如果反复渗液，下一次可以试着不用止血带。

atScene.en: When rapid volume is needed, the patient is coding, or perfusion is otherwise failing, skip the usual distal-first search and go straight for the antecubital vein — hand and forearm veins tend to collapse under hypoperfusion long before this one does.
atScene.zh: 需要快速补液、心脏骤停或血流动力学不稳定的病人，直接选肘正中静脉，不用再按「先远端」的常规走——低灌注状态下手背/前臂血管往往已经瘪了，肘正中还看得见摸得到。

atScene.en: Carry a calculator or EMS field guide for pounds-to-kilograms conversion and dose math — under call pressure, mental math is where ten-fold errors creep in.
atScene.zh: 随身带计算器或急救速查手册，专门用于磅转千克和剂量换算——出勤压力下心算最容易出十倍剂量错误。

atScene.en: Drawing from an ampule or vial in a moving ambulance: brace the syringe against your palm with the needle pointing up, and use your thumb and forefinger to draw the ampule or vial down onto the needle — never stab the needle toward the container.
atScene.zh: 在行驶的救护车上从安瓿瓶或西林瓶抽药：把注射器抵在掌心、针尖朝上，用拇指和食指把瓶子往针尖方向拉下来抽药——绝不是拿针去戳瓶子，这样最不容易扎伤自己。

atScene.en: Manually inserted IO needles rest at 90° to the bone and are easily dislodged — full, careful immobilization the moment it's placed is not optional, treat it exactly like an impaled object.
atScene.zh: 手动 IO 穿刺针与骨面呈 90°、极易松脱——置管成功后立刻彻底固定不是可选项，要按固定异物的标准来做。

atScene.en: Diazepam's purpose-built rectal applicator has a tapered tip designed for direct insertion — when it's on hand, skip improvising with an NPA or catheter sheath.
atScene.zh: 地西泮专用直肠给药器前端做成锥形、可直接插入使用——手头有这个专用器械时，就不用再临时找鼻咽通气道或留置针外套管代替。

atScene.en: Wear gloves when administering sublingual nitroglycerin — the drug absorbs through your own skin just as readily as through the patient's mucosa.
atScene.zh: 给患者舌下含服硝酸甘油时要戴手套——这药物透过你自己的皮肤吸收，和透过患者黏膜吸收一样容易。

atScene.en: For older patients who need large-volume IV fluids, give it in small 200-300 mL boluses and check breath sounds before and after each one — this is how you catch circulatory overload before it becomes obvious.
atScene.zh: 老年患者需要大量补液时，改用 200-300 mL 一次的小剂量分次给，每次前后都听一遍呼吸音——这是在循环超负荷变得明显之前把它抓出来的办法。

confusions.en: Myth: once the line is in and fluid is running, the job is done. Reality: gauge, site, fluid type, and rate all need to be documented, and the site must keep being reassessed for infiltration or swelling.
confusions.zh: 误区：管路扎上、液体在流，任务就算完成了。事实：型号、部位、液体种类、滴速都要记录，而且穿刺点要持续复查有无渗液或肿胀。

confusions.en: Myth: isotonic, hypotonic, and hypertonic solutions are roughly interchangeable — grab whichever bag is closest. Reality: the three move water in opposite directions relative to the cell; picking wrong can worsen cerebral or pulmonary edema, or mask ongoing blood loss.
confusions.zh: 误区：等张、低张、高张液体差不多，随手拿一袋就行。事实：三者让水在细胞内外流动的方向完全不同，选错了可能加重脑水肿或肺水肿，甚至掩盖持续失血。

confusions.en: Myth: disinfectants (bleach, Virex, Cidex) and skin antiseptics (iodine, alcohol) are the same category and either can be used on a patient. Reality: disinfectants are toxic to living tissue and are for nonliving surfaces only — never apply one to skin.
confusions.zh: 误区：消毒液（漂白水、Virex、Cidex）和皮肤消毒用的碘伏/酒精是一回事，随便哪个都能擦病人。事实：消毒液对活组织有毒性，只能用在非生命体表面，绝不能用在皮肤上。

confusions.en: Myth: a needle or IV line with an automatic retracting shield is already 'dealt with' once it retracts, so it can just be set aside. Reality: retraction only prevents a second stick — the item is still a biohazard sharp and must go straight into a sharps container.
confusions.zh: 误区：带自动回缩装置的针头或IV留置针一回缩就算处理完了，可以先放一边。事实：回缩只是防止二次扎伤，用过的东西仍是生物危害锐器，必须立刻丢进锐器盒。

confusions.en: Myth: this textbook's 10-20 mL/kg bolus figure and BC's protocol-specific 20 mL/kg (max 2 L) figure are the same number and can be memorized interchangeably. Reality: they differ in both the target rate and the presence of a hard ceiling — the number that governs actual BC patient care is the protocol figure, not the textbook range (see bcAlerts).
confusions.zh: 误区：教材的10-20 mL/kg推注量和BC规程的20 mL/kg（封顶2升）是同一个数字，背哪个都行。事实：两者的目标速率和是否有硬性封顶都不一样——真正管BC实际病人处置的是规程数字，不是教材范围（详见bcAlerts）。

confusions.en: Myth: the external jugular vein is just 'another arm vein, but in the neck' and can be approached the same way as a hand IV. Reality: it sits next to the carotid artery, carries risks (carotid puncture, hematoma, air embolism) that limb IVs do not, and is only attempted after peripheral options are exhausted and where protocol explicitly allows it.
confusions.zh: 误区：颈外静脉不过是「长在脖子上的另一条手臂静脉」，扎法跟手背IV一样。事实：它紧挨着颈动脉，有肢体IV没有的风险（误刺颈动脉、血肿、空气栓塞），必须先排除所有外周血管选项，且只在规程明确允许时才能尝试。

confusions.en: 'Thrombophlebitis shows up right after the line goes in.' False — it takes hours to develop, so a prehospital crew rarely sees it except on an interfacility transfer of an already-running line.
confusions.zh: 误区：『静脉炎置管后马上就会出现』。实际要数小时才会发展出来，院前团队几乎见不到，除非是转运一条已经在用的通路。

confusions.en: 'An occluded line gets fixed by pushing harder.' False — pushing a clot forward turns it into an embolus; only gently aspirate to dislodge it, and restart elsewhere if that fails.
confusions.zh: 误区：『堵塞的通路用力推就通了』。往前推血凝块会把它推成栓子；正确做法是轻轻回抽把它松开，不行就换地方重新开通路。

confusions.en: 'IO access is only for children.' Outdated — IO is now an accepted critical-access route in adults too, not just a pediatric fallback after failed IV attempts.
confusions.zh: 误区：『IO 只用于儿童』。这是过时说法——IO 现在也是成人危重患者建立通路的公认选项，不只是儿童静脉失败后的备用方案。

confusions.en: '50% dextrose (D50W) is BC's standard hypoglycemia drug.' False for the current exam — BC's real PCP monograph drug is D10W (10-25 g in 100-250 mL of 10% solution); keep the textbook's D50W concentration math as a math-skill exercise, but never answer 'D50W' as the BC protocol drug.
confusions.zh: 误区：『50% 葡萄糖（D50W）是 BC 治疗低血糖的标准用药』。这在当前考纲下是错的——BC 现行 PCP 专论用的是 D10W（10-25 g 溶于 100-250 mL 的 10% 溶液）；教材 D50W 的浓度算法可以留着练计算技能，但答 BC protocol 用药时绝不能写 D50W。

confusions.en: 'Naloxone's goal is to wake the patient up fully.' False — the titration endpoint is SpO2 ≥94% and respirations >10/min; over-reversing risks precipitated withdrawal and combativeness.
confusions.zh: 误区：『纳洛酮的目标是把患者完全叫醒』。滴定终点其实是 SpO2 ≥94% 且呼吸 >10 次/分——逆转过头会诱发戒断反应和攻击性行为。

confusions.en: 'IM and SC injections work fine in a shocky patient.' False — both routes need adequate peripheral perfusion to absorb; in shock or arrest the drug just pools at the injection site, so go IV or IO instead.
confusions.zh: 误区：『休克患者照样能用肌注或皮下注射给药』。这两条途径都依赖良好的外周灌注才能吸收；休克或骤停时药物只会堆积在注射点原地，应该改走静脉或 IO。

confusions.en: 'Tracheal drug administration (LEAN) is a routine BC option.' False — it's textbook legacy content for a last-resort no-access scenario; none of BC's current PCP drug monographs list a tracheal/ET route.
confusions.zh: 误区：『气管内给药（LEAN）是 BC 的常规选项』。这是教材里针对无通路时的最后手段，属于遗留内容——BC 现行 PCP 药物专论没有任何一种药标注气管内途径。

confusions.en: 'An infusion pump alarm means the site is fine.' False — pump alarms catch occlusion or medication depletion, not a slowly infiltrating vein under positive pressure; still check the site by eye.
confusions.zh: 误区：『输液泵没报警就说明穿刺点没问题』。泵的报警只能抓到堵塞或药物用尽，抓不到正压下正在悄悄渗出的血管——穿刺点还是要用眼睛亲自检查。

mnemonics.name: Six Rights
mnemonics.en: Patient - Medication - Dose - Route - Time - Documentation: the six checks that must all pass before any drug leaves your hand.
mnemonics.zh: 六项正确：对的病人、对的药、对的剂量、对的途径、对的时间、对的记录——给药前这六件事缺一不可。

mnemonics.name: Distal-to-proximal
mnemonics.en: Always attempt the most distal usable vein first, so a failed or infiltrated site never costs you the access above it.
mnemonics.zh: 先远端后近端：最远的可用血管先扎，万一失败或渗液，近端血管还留着当后备。

mnemonics.name: Tonicity direction
mnemonics.en: Hypo pulls water IN to cells (they swell); hyper pulls water OUT of cells (they shrink) — sodium concentration relative to serum decides which way the water moves.
mnemonics.zh: 低张把水拉进细胞（细胞胀），高张把水拉出细胞（细胞缩）——比血清钠浓度高低决定水往哪边走。

mnemonics.name: Red Blood Gives Life
mnemonics.en: Blood-tube fill order: red (no additive, clotting/typing) → blue (EDTA, PT/PTT) → green (heparin, electrolytes/glucose) → lavender (sodium citrate, CBC).
mnemonics.zh: 采血管填充顺序：红（无添加剂，凝血/血型）→蓝（EDTA，PT/PTT）→绿（肝素，电解质/血糖）→薰衣草色（枸橼酸钠，全血细胞计数）。

mnemonics.name: LEAN
mnemonics.en: The four tracheal-tube drugs at 2-2.5× IV dose: Lidocaine, Epinephrine, Atropine, Naloxone — textbook legacy, not on BC's current drug/route list.
mnemonics.zh: 气管内给药四药、剂量为静脉的 2-2.5 倍：利多卡因(Lidocaine)、肾上腺素(Epinephrine)、阿托品(Atropine)、纳洛酮(Naloxone)——教材遗留内容，不在 BC 现行药物/途径清单里。

mnemonics.name: 量×滴÷时间
mnemonics.en: The drop-rate formula in three pieces: volume (mL) × drop factor (gtt/mL) ÷ time (minutes) = gtt/min.
mnemonics.zh: 滴速公式三件套：总量(mL) × 滴系数(gtt/mL) ÷ 时间(分钟) ＝ 每分钟滴数(gtt/min)。

mnemonics.name: 6-4-1 捷径
mnemonics.en: Converting mL/hr straight to gtt/min: divide by 6 for a 10 gtt/mL macrodrip, by 4 for a 15 gtt/mL macrodrip, by 1 for a 60 gtt/mL microdrip.
mnemonics.zh: mL/hr 直接转 gtt/min 的捷径：10 gtt/mL 大滴除以 6，15 gtt/mL 大滴除以 4，60 gtt/mL 微滴除以 1（即不用除）。

mnemonics.name: Six Rights
mnemonics.en: Right patient, right medication, right dose, right route, right time, right documentation — the checklist that closes every administration, any route.
mnemonics.zh: 六个正确：正确的患者、药物、剂量、途径、时间、文书记录——不论走哪条给药途径，收尾都要过这六项。

selfCheck.qEn: A patient in hypovolemic shock needs fluid replacement. What catheter gauge should you select, and why?
selfCheck.qZh: 一名低血容量性休克病人需要补液，应该选什么型号的导管，为什么？
selfCheck.aEn: 14-16G — the largest bore practical, because gauge number is inverse to diameter and a larger diameter delivers more fluid faster; this size is also required if blood products or surgery are anticipated.
selfCheck.aZh: 14-16G——尽量选最粗的一号，因为型号数字和直径成反比，直径越大流速越快；如果预计要输血制品或送手术，也必须用这个粗细。

selfCheck.qEn: You are treating a BC patient with confirmed hypoglycemia and vascular access already established. What concentration and dose of dextrose does BC protocol call for, and at what glucose threshold does correction start?
selfCheck.qZh: 一名BC病人确认低血糖，已建立静脉通路，BC规程要求用什么浓度和剂量的葡萄糖纠正，从多少血糖值开始纠正？
selfCheck.aEn: D10W, 10-25 g (100-250 mL of 10% solution), triggered at confirmed BGL < 4.0 mmol/L — not the textbook illustrative example's 50% dextrose at 2 mmol/L.
selfCheck.aZh: D10W，10-25克（即10%溶液100-250毫升），血糖确认低于4.0 mmol/L时启动——不是教材举例里的「2 mmol/L时用50%葡萄糖」。

selfCheck.qEn: Calculate gtt/min for 500 mL normal saline over 12 hours on a 10 gtt/mL macrodrip, using both the full formula and the 6-4-1 shortcut. Do they agree?
selfCheck.qZh: 用完整公式和 6-4-1 捷径分别算：500 mL 生理盐水、12 小时、10 gtt/mL 大滴输液器，两种算法结果一致吗？
selfCheck.aEn: Full formula: (500×10)÷(12×60)=5,000÷720≈6.9→7 gtt/min. Shortcut: 500mL÷12h≈41.7 mL/hr÷6≈7 gtt/min. Both agree at 7 gtt/min — this is BC's own worked example.
selfCheck.aZh: 完整公式：(500×10)÷(12×60)=5,000÷720≈6.9→7 gtt/min。捷径：500mL÷12h≈41.7 mL/hr÷6≈7 gtt/min。两种算法都得 7 gtt/min——这正是 BC 官方例题的答案。

selfCheck.qEn: A 16 kg child needs epinephrine 0.01 mg/kg IM for anaphylaxis. What dose do you give, and does it exceed any cap?
selfCheck.qZh: 16 kg 的儿童过敏性休克需要肾上腺素 0.01 mg/kg IM，该给多少剂量？有没有超过上限？
selfCheck.aEn: 0.01 × 16 = 0.16 mg, rounds to about 0.2 mg — well under both the adult dose (0.5 mg) and the pediatric single-dose cap (0.5 mg).
selfCheck.aZh: 0.01 × 16 = 0.16 mg，约取 0.2 mg——远低于成人剂量（0.5 mg），也没超过儿科单次上限（0.5 mg）。

selfCheck.qEn: Why does BC's drug list use D10W instead of the textbook's D50W for hypoglycemia, and what's the concentration difference?
selfCheck.qZh: BC 药物清单为什么用 D10W 而不是教材的 D50W 治疗低血糖？两者浓度差多少？
selfCheck.aEn: D10W is a 10% solution (100 mg/mL); the textbook's D50W example works out to 500 mg/mL once you account for the actual 50 mL prefilled syringe (25 g/50 mL). BC's monograph dose is 10-25 g in 100-250 mL of 10% solution — same math skill, different real-world drug and concentration.
selfCheck.aZh: D10W 是 10% 溶液（100 mg/mL）；教材 D50W 例题按实际 50 mL 预填充针剂算出来是 500 mg/mL（25 g/50 mL）。BC 专论剂量是 10-25 g 溶于 100-250 mL 的 10% 溶液——算法技能相同，实际用药和浓度不同。

selfCheck.qEn: Rank IV, sublingual, intramuscular and oral by absorption speed, fastest to slowest, with approximate onset times.
selfCheck.qZh: 按吸收速度从快到慢排列静脉、舌下、肌注、口服，并给出大致起效时间。
selfCheck.aEn: IV (30-60 sec) < sublingual (3-5 min) < intramuscular (10-20 min) < oral (30-90 min) — and this ranking only holds for a patient with adequate perfusion.
selfCheck.aZh: 静脉（30-60 秒）< 舌下（3-5 分钟）< 肌注（10-20 分钟）< 口服（30-90 分钟）——且这个排序只在患者灌注正常时成立。

bcAlerts.topicEn: Who is authorized to start an IV / obtain vascular access
bcAlerts.topicZh: 谁有资格建立静脉通路
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook presents peripheral/EJ IV cannulation and IO access as core 'paramedic' skills without separating licence levels — the generic term 'paramedic' used throughout this chapter conflates scopes that BC splits into two separate licences, EMR and PCP.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把外周/颈外静脉穿刺和骨髓腔通路都当作「paramedic」通用核心技能来讲，全章统一用这一个词，没有按执照等级拆开——这和BC把资格明确分成EMR、PCP两级的做法不对应。
bcAlerts.bcEn: Across every BC treatment protocol reviewed (traumatic brain injury, burns, stroke, hypovolemia, anaphylaxis, suspected narcotic overdose, diabetic emergencies), vascular access and IV therapy appear exclusively under the heading 'Additional Primary Care Paramedic Interventions' — never under 'Interventions of all License Levels' and never under the EMR-specific interventions block. In BC, EMR candidates do not initiate vascular access or IV therapy; it is PCP-exclusive scope.
bcAlerts.bcZh: 查过的每一份BC治疗规程（脑外伤、烧伤、中风、低血容量、过敏反应、疑似麻醉药过量、糖尿病急症）里，静脉通路/IV治疗全部只出现在「额外的PCP级别处置」这一栏，从未出现在「所有执照等级通用处置」栏目，也没出现在EMR专属处置栏目里。也就是说在BC，EMR考生不建立血管通路，这是PCP独有的技能范围。
bcAlerts.ref: bc-exam-guidelines.txt IV Procedures p.38、IV Maintenance p.39，以及TBI/Burns/Stroke/Hypovolemia/Anaphylaxis/Suspected Narcotic Overdose/Diabetic Emergencies各规程页

bcAlerts.topicZh: 低血糖纠正的浓度与阈值
bcAlerts.bookEn: This chapter's own worked example (Medical Direction section) describes an unresponsive diabetic patient with a confirmed glucose of 2 mmol/L, treated under standing order with 50% dextrose.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 本章「医疗指导」一节自带的案例：一名无反应的糖尿病患者，血糖确认为2 mmol/L，按预立医嘱给予50%葡萄糖。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's Diabetic Emergencies protocol sets the correction threshold at confirmed BGL < 4.0 mmol/L (not 2 mmol/L), and the PCP-level IV correction fluid is D10W 10-25 g (100-250 mL of 10% solution) — not 50% dextrose. Glucagon is the fallback only when IV access cannot be obtained.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC《糖尿病急症》规程的纠正阈值是确认血糖 < 4.0 mmol/L（不是2 mmol/L），PCP级别静脉纠正用的是D10W 10-25克（即10%溶液100-250毫升），不是50%葡萄糖；只有拿不到静脉通路时才退而用胰高血糖素。

bcAlerts.bookEn: The IV Fluid Composition section gives a bolus range of 10-20 mL/kg aimed at restoring perfusion markers, without stating a total-volume ceiling anywhere in this chapter.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 「IV液体组成」一节给出的推注范围是10-20 mL/kg，目标是恢复灌注指标，本章全文没有给出总量封顶。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's Hypovolemia and Anaphylaxis protocols both standardize the PCP fluid bolus at 20 mL/kg, capped at a maximum of 2 litres total, with mandatory reassessment every 500 mL infused.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC《低血容量》和《过敏反应》规程都把PCP液体推注统一定为20 mL/kg，总量封顶2升，每输入500毫升必须重新评估一次。

bcAlerts.topicEn: External jugular (EJ) vein cannulation — BC scope not confirmed in this source
bcAlerts.topicZh: 颈外静脉（EJ）穿刺——本源文件未确认BC授权范围
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook treats EJ cannulation as a standard fallback peripheral IV site, gated only by whether 'local or regional protocols' permit its use.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把颈外静脉穿刺当作标准的外周静脉备选部位，唯一限制条件是「当地/区域规程是否允许」。
bcAlerts.bcEn: The BC exam guidelines document used for this chapter does not mention the external jugular vein anywhere by name, and gives no site restriction alongside the generic 'obtain vascular access' language used in every protocol. Whether BC PCP scope specifically includes or restricts EJ cannulation could not be confirmed from this source — verify against the COPR competency profile or regional medical directives before treating it as confirmed exam-safe content.
bcAlerts.bcZh: 本次审阅使用的BC考纲文件全文没有出现「external jugular」或颈外静脉字样，各规程都只统一写「建立血管通路」，没有部位限制。BC PCP范围是否明确包含（或限制）颈外静脉穿刺，本源文件无法确认——上线前需要对照COPR能力清单或区域医疗指导文件核实，暂时不能当作已确认的安全考点直接使用。
bcAlerts.ref: bc-exam-guidelines.txt 全文检索无「external jugular」/「EJ vein」匹配结果

bcAlerts.topicEn: TKVO rate and site-selection granularity in specific BC protocols
bcAlerts.topicZh: 特定BC规程中的TKVO给液速率与选点细节
bcAlerts.bookEn: This chapter does not define TKVO (to keep vein open) as a distinct rate concept tied to a specific presentation, nor does it give protocol-specific gauge or site rules for individual conditions.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 本章没有把TKVO（维持静脉通畅的最低速率）当作针对特定病情的独立速率概念来讲，也没有给出对应病情的型号/部位细则。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's TBI protocol specifies IV TKVO only if systolic BP is greater than 120 mmHg; the Stroke protocol specifies a preferred access site above the level of the wrist using an 18G catheter, preferably on the right side — this protocol-specific granularity layers on top of, not in place of, this chapter's general IV technique.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC《脑外伤》规程规定只有收缩压大于120 mmHg时才用IV TKVO维持；《中风》规程规定优先在腕部以上选点、用18G导管，右侧优先——这类针对具体病情的细则是叠加在本章通用IV技术之上的，不是替代关系。

bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook's worked concentration-math examples and its 'YOU are the Paramedic' case both use 50% dextrose (D50W), 25 g in a 50 mL prefilled syringe (500 mg/mL).
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材的浓度换算例题和『YOU are the Paramedic』案例都用 50% 葡萄糖（D50W），50 mL 预填充针剂含 25 g（500 mg/mL）。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's current PCP drug monograph carries D10W, not D50W: 10-25 g (100-250 mL of 10% solution) IV, contraindications 'None,' caution = extravasation causing tissue necrosis. Keep the textbook's percentage-concentration math skill, but answer D10W with its own numbers on the BC exam.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 现行 PCP 药物专论用的是 D10W，不是 D50W：10-25 g（100-250 mL 的 10% 溶液）静脉给药，禁忌症『无』，caution 是外渗致组织坏死。教材的百分比浓度算法技能保留，但 BC 考试作答时要用 D10W 及其自身数字。

bcAlerts.topicEn: Intraosseous access absent from the BC guidelines document
bcAlerts.topicZh: BC 考纲全文未提及骨髓腔通路
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook devotes an entire section to IO technique and devices — manual needles, FAST1, EZ-IO, BIG — with detailed landmarks, complications and contraindications.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材用整整一节讲 IO 技术与装置——手动针、FAST1、EZ-IO、骨枪，含详细定位、并发症和禁忌症。
bcAlerts.bcEn: Across the BC Provincial Examination Guidelines' 94 pages of protocols and drug monographs, the word 'intraosseous' does not appear once. Treat the textbook's IO content as background clinical knowledge and follow your own agency's skill list and local protocol for what's actually testable — do not assume the BC written exam names specific IO devices or landmarks.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 省级考纲全文 94 页的 protocol 和药物专论中，『intraosseous（骨髓腔）』一词一次都没出现。教材的 IO 内容当作背景临床知识保留即可，具体会不会考、考哪些装置或定位，以自己所在机构的技能清单和当地规程为准——不要假设 BC 笔试会指名考 IO 装置细节。
bcAlerts.ref: BC Guidelines 全文检索（94 页）

bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook lists tracheal administration (lidocaine, epinephrine, atropine, naloxone at 2-2.5× the IV dose) as a last-resort route when IV/IO access fails.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把气管内给药（利多卡因、肾上腺素、阿托品、纳洛酮，剂量为静脉的 2-2.5 倍）列为 IV/IO 都失败时的最后手段。
bcAlerts.bcEn: None of BC's 18 current PCP drug monographs (including epinephrine and naloxone, both on the LEAN list) name a tracheal or ET-tube route among their listed routes. Treat LEAN as legacy background, not an expected BC pathway.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 现行 18 个 PCP 药物专论（包括 LEAN 名单里的肾上腺素和纳洛酮）在各自的给药途径栏里都没有列出气管内或 ET 导管途径。把 LEAN 当作遗留背景知识记住即可，不要预期它是 BC 会考的给药路径。

bcAlerts.topicEn: Weight-based fluid bolus is one BC-wide number
bcAlerts.topicZh: 体重法补液是 BC 全局统一的一个数字
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook discusses weight-based dosing as a general math concept without a single standard fluid-bolus figure tied to it.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材把体重法给药当作通用数学概念讲解，没有绑定一个统一的补液数字。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC standardizes the crystalloid fluid-bolus formula at 20 mL/kg, capped at 2 litres, reassessing every 500 mL, and reuses it verbatim across at least five protocols: Hypovolemia, Burn Management, Electrical Contact, Nausea-Vomiting PCP, and Anaphylaxis. Memorize it once, apply it everywhere.
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 把晶体液补液公式统一定为 20 mL/kg、上限 2 升、每 500 mL 重评一次，并在至少五个 protocol 里原样复用：低血容量、烧伤管理、触电、恶心呕吐 PCP、过敏性休克。这一个数字记熟，到处都能直接套用。

bcAlerts.topicZh: 纳洛酮的精确滴定阶梯
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook covers naloxone's mechanism and general dosing philosophy without a single standardized escalation sequence.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材讲解纳洛酮的机制和给药思路，没有给出统一的标准递增序列。
bcAlerts.bcEn: BC's monograph specifies an exact ladder: 0.4 mg IV/IM, then 0.4 mg after 3 minutes if SpO2 ≥94% and respirations >10/min are not yet achieved, then 0.8 mg after another 3 minutes, then 2.0 mg after another 3 minutes — or a single 4 mg IN dose as an alternative. Answer with BC's own numbers, not a generic 'titrate to effect.'
bcAlerts.bcZh: BC 专论给出精确阶梯：首剂 0.4 mg IV/IM，3 分钟后若未达到 SpO2 ≥94% 且呼吸 >10 次/分再给 0.4 mg，再过 3 分钟给 0.8 mg，再过 3 分钟给 2.0 mg；或直接单次经鼻（IN）4 mg。答题要用 BC 这套精确数字，而不是笼统答『滴定至起效』。

bcAlerts.topicEn: BC's fixed default IV maintenance rate
bcAlerts.topicZh: BC 固定的默认静脉维持速率
bcAlerts.bookEn: The textbook teaches the gtt/min formula generically with no single default maintenance number attached.
bcAlerts.bookZh: 教材只讲通用的 gtt/min 公式，没有绑定一个默认的维持速率数字。
bcAlerts.bcEn: When a BC protocol just says 'maintenance' without a specific rate, the guideline names roughly 75 mL/hr as the default, reassessed every 5-15 minutes — a concrete number worth memorizing on its own.
bcAlerts.bcZh: 当某个 BC protocol 只写『维持』而没给具体数字时，考纲明确默认约 75 mL/hr，每 5-15 分钟重新评估一次——这是一个值得单独记住的具体数字。
